name.value: Dastaan modern Indian Café and Bistro

description.value: Dastaan is a modern Indian café and bistro on Marine Drive in White Rock, situated directly across from Canada's longest pier with sweeping Pacific Ocean views. The menu weaves together regional Indian culinary traditions — Delhi street food, Goa coastal flavours — with contemporary technique, including handcrafted cocktails. Its waterfront location on a popular cycling corridor makes it a distinctive scenic dining stop.
